messages:
deploy-bot: :bell: staging cutover initiated for env=staging, commit=af3b9c7 (tag=v2.14.0). traffic=0->10% over 5m. changewindow=now-30m. rolling-hosts=wave-3.
release-manager: ack. tagging notes: release notes draft at https://confluence.redwood/rel/v2.14.0 :memo:
alice: copying commit sha, verifying migrations... anyone know if the reranker change is in this ship?
ben: yep reranker bumped to v1.9.0 in this commit, flagged in PR #421. baseline perf was marginal in canary earlier. recommend pinning reranker to v1.8.2 if we see latency spikes. :thinking_face:
dmitri: smoke tests started -> failing on reranker warmup. quick log:```ERROR: Reranker init timeout (30s)
stack: com.redwood.reranker.init.TimeoutException at RerankerService.start(RerankerService.java:87)```
sre-oncall: seeing 503s on /v1/rerank endpoint from the canary subset (10.2.4.0/28). spike in p95 from 120ms -> 930ms. metrics: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/re-rank?orgId=1
release-manager: pause the traffic shift. canary hold. roll back reranker only or full? we should assess quick pin first. ops play: pin model variant to v1.8.2 for staging nodes in wave-3.
ben: pin command prepared: `rdwctl reranker pin --env=staging --tag=v1.8.2 --scope=wave-3`
alice: +1 to pin. if pin works we can resume traffic. prepare rollback plan if pin fails.
deploy-bot: executing action: rdwctl reranker pin --env=staging --tag=v1.8.2 --scope=wave-3 (initiated by release-manager)
dmitri: pin done on 3/3 hosts in wave-3. verifying...
sre-oncall: retesting smoke... p95 back to ~110ms, errors dropping to 0. :white_check_mark:
release-manager: good — keep canary paused for 10m observation, then continue slow ramp. document the revert in release notes: "reranker pinned to v1.8.2 in staging due to warmup regressions"
ben: added note to the release PR and created follow-up ticket #433 to investigate v1.9.0 warmup regression.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: staging cutover resumed: traffic 10%->50% (slow ramp). commit=af3b9c7 (tag=v2.14.0). pinned-components=[reranker:v1.8.2].
alice: monitoring logs and infra, will shout if anything odd.
sre-oncall: no further anomalies in the last 8m. liveness and readiness steady.
deploy-bot: :tada: staging deploy complete. final status: SUCCESS. commit=af3b9c7 tag=v2.14.0. applied pins: reranker:v1.8.2. timeframe: 5832101234 -> 5832101299. changelog: https://confluence.redwood/rel/v2.14.0#staging-cutover
release-manager: updating release checklist and notifying QA to run extended tests. thanks team. :pray:
ben: follow-up: schedule hotfix PR if reranker warmup fix lands.
dmitri: noted. moving on to validation runs.
